cases.name: Erica Burden
cases.about: Her family described Erica as kind, caring and an incredible mother.
cases.narrative: On 11/11/2021, her remains were found near a highway in Upton. She had disappeared after dropping her daughter off at school. It is believed that he had lured Erica to his residence in Upton, KY where he shot and killed her inside of her vehicle, then he hid her body, as well as the murder weapon, Erica’s purse, and a cell phone, in a sinkhole which he then covered with dirt and debris.
